about: A pattern is at most 200 code points long (chapter 3 § 3.5.3). Invalid: the agent node plan's if matches the draft against an alternation of drug names 201 code points long. Valid: 200, the limit.
sentences: Node 'plan' pattern "letrozole|femara|letrozole|femara|letrozole|femara|letrozole|femara|letrozole|femara|letrozole|femara|letrozole|femara|letrozole|femara|letrozole|femara|letrozole|femara|letrozole|femara|letrozole|fema" is 201 characters long; the most is 200.
